blocks.text: The narrative turns toward Kangar and Tappa, where the Guru reaches the region around Lakhmir and is briefly received there after the dispersals that followed the river crossing. (1–3)

The page also looks back toward the separated family, noting how the younger Sahibzadas had been cut off in the confusion and how Mata Gujri was carried away from the Guru's side during the crisis after Sarsa. (4–6)
Thus episode 20 closes by linking Machhiwara with the beginning of the Kangar sequence: hiding, separation, and fresh local shelters are all now part of one broken but continuing journey. (7)
